subject: SIG evidence coverage questions — MediSphere

From: Elena Park <elena.park@medisphere.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@medisphere.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: SIG Evidence — items needed for procurement review

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Procurement is running the SIG intake for our contract review and asked me to request the following artifacts so we can close the security assessment:

• SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) — we understand there may be redacted versions
• Pen test executive summary (we don't need raw findings, an executive paragraph + remediation status is fine)
• ISO 27001 attestation or statements of scope
• A high-level security deck (slide deck) we can share with stakeholders

Can you confirm which of these you can provide, and whether any require an NDA/DocuSign before sharing? We'd like to have the materials by Friday 16 Jun to keep our procurement timeline.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Elena Park
Sr. Security Program Manager
MediSphere Health
elena.park@medisphere.com

From: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Park <elena.park@medisphere.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG Evidence — items needed for procurement review

Elena — thanks for the clear list and the timeline. We're on it.

Quick plan:
• I'll coordinate internally and confirm what we can share publicly vs. what needs a DPA/NDA.
• Vanessa will confirm SOC2 distribution rules and provide a redacted copy if required.
• Marissa will surface a pen-test executive summary and the current remediation status.
• Rishi will confirm ISO statements and the security slide deck version we can send out.

Tentative ETA: EOD Thu, 15 Jun (so you have time before Fri 16 Jun). If procurement insists on DocuSign before access, we can send a DocuSign envelope with a one-way NDA today.

Any specific formatting preferences (PDF, slide deck, single ZIP) let us know.

- Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG Evidence — items needed for procurement review

Elena / team — quick update from compliance side:

• SOC 2 Type II (period ending 2027-08) — we have a redacted distribution-ready PDF we provide to customers after an access agreement. The redactions are limited to internal IP and vendor names.
• Pen test — we cannot share raw findings; we provide a one-page Executive Summary (attached) that lists scope, high-level findings, and remediation status.
• ISO 27001 — Redwood maintains third-party statements of conformity; we have a short attestation file (attached).
• Security deck — the public v2 deck is available; we can create a slightly redacted version if needed for RFPs.

I will upload the documents to our secure share and trigger a DocuSign envelope for the distribution agreement unless you confirm you already have an NDA on file with Redwood.

Attachments referenced:
- pen_test_exec_summary_2027.pdf (one-pager)
- ISO27001_attestation_2026.txt

If procurement would prefer DocuSign first, please confirm and we'll send the envelope immediately.

Vanessa Ortiz
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Hi all — thank you, this looks good.

Procurement confirmed they will sign the DocuSign today and accept the redacted SOC2 + the pen test executive summary and ISO attestation. A couple quick asks:

• Can you include a single-line statement in the security deck about data residency options (we operate in US + EU)?
• We prefer the ZIP to be encrypted with a passphrase; please email the passphrase separately (or provide a phone number to call).

If you can get the ZIP and DocuSign link to us by EOD Thu, that will keep our review on track for Mon 19 Jun.

Elena
